The source records only a reported curator conversation in which the transcriber wrote "It was restored before the exhibition" while explicitly marking the pronoun referent as unresolved, with the preceding question omitted. The candidate asserts flatly that the stage hatch was closed at the closing bell, but the packet contains two directly conflicting signed inspections of the same single hatch and the same closing bell: the east steward records it closed (s0) and the west steward records it open (s1).
